description: Definitional bridge, not a derivation: the conclusion is the conjunction of the two premises in the shared case signature (the pilot's State.core). It is not a single application of one hypothesis, so corpus.py counts it as a proof: stage 4 is closed by it, and its two pilot cells, both open, become the open items in its place. Progress on stage 4 now means defending STMT-PILOT-JESUS-CLAIMS and STMT-PILOT-ROSE.
